LanguageData.PhobosFlight_TakeOffDesc: Lift the {VEHICLE} straight up from where it stands and hold it in a hover over the map. Its engines must be running, its crew aboard and the sky above it open, and it must be light enough to hover in today's air. Too heavy to lift straight up, it rolls along a strip of clear, open ground ahead of it, shown while it is selected, and circles once it is up.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_FlyToDesc: Pick a spot on the map. The {VEHICLE} turns, flies there over anything in the way and holds in a hover; if it cannot hover, it circles over the spot. You can also right-click the ground with it selected.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_HoldDesc: Stop the {VEHICLE} as soon as it can and hold it in a hover. If it cannot hover, it circles where it is instead.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_CircleDesc: Pick a spot. The {VEHICLE} flies round it, at the size and way round chosen beside this button, until you give it another order. It can circle when it is too heavy to hover.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_CircleSettingsDesc: Choose how wide the {VEHICLE} circles and which way round. A circle under way changes at once.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RopeDownDesc: From a steady hover, the {VEHICLE} comes down to about {METRES} m and everyone in a passenger's or crew chief's seat slides down the fast ropes, two at a time, onto the ground behind the ramp. Then it climbs back. It must hold still the whole time: if it has to come down, whoever is on a rope falls.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_HoistDesc: Lift someone of yours from the ground behind the ramp, or lower someone from aboard, one at a time. From a steady hover the {VEHICLE} comes down low and lowers the hook; a downed person goes up in the stretcher onto a litter if one is fitted and free. It takes a person and their gear up to {RATED} kg, draws heavily on the battery and needs someone aboard to work it. About a minute a lift.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_HoistNobody: Nobody to lift within {CELLS} cells of the hoist, and nobody aboard to lower
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_StopLinesDesc: Send nobody more down the ropes or on the hoist. Whoever is on a line now finishes, then the {VEHICLE} climbs back up.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_LandDesc: Pick a clear, open spot and which way to face. The {VEHICLE} flies over it, turns and comes straight down. It needs open sky and firm ground with nothing built on it. If it cannot hover, it lands rolling instead: it touches down at the spot and rolls on ahead, so the ground in front of the spot must be clear too.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseNotOnGround: The {VEHICLE} is not standing on the ground.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseEnginesOff: The {VEHICLE}'s engines are not running: draft it first.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseCrew: The {VEHICLE} does not have the crew it needs to fly.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseRoof: There is a roof over part of the {VEHICLE}: it needs open sky to lift off.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseTooHeavy: The {VEHICLE} is too heavy to lift straight up in this air. Unload it, wait for cooler air, or repair its engines.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseNotFlying: The {VEHICLE} is not flying steadily enough to take that order now.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseOffMap: That is beyond the edge of the map.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseNotMoving: The {VEHICLE} is not flying anywhere to stop.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseBoard: Nobody can climb aboard the {VEHICLE} while it is in the air.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseLoad: Nothing can be loaded into the {VEHICLE} while it is in the air.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseUnload: Nothing can be unloaded from the {VEHICLE} while it is in the air.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseRolling: The {VEHICLE} is still moving on the ground: let it stop first.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseTooHeavyShed: The {VEHICLE} is too heavy to take off at all in this air, even rolling. Take about {KILOGRAMS} kg out of it, wait for cooler air, or repair its engines.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseStrip: The {VEHICLE} is too heavy to lift straight up, so it must roll {CELLS} cells straight ahead to take off, and that strip will not do: {WHY}. Turn it or move it to clear, open ground.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseLinesBusy: The {VEHICLE} is already working its ropes or hoist.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseLinesNotHovering: The {VEHICLE} must be hovering steadily for its ropes or hoist: stop it in a hover first.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseLinesOut: The {VEHICLE} has people on its ropes or hoist: wait for them, or press Stop and wait for the last one.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseNoRopes: The {VEHICLE} has no fast-rope bar fitted.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseNoHoist: The {VEHICLE} has no rescue hoist fitted.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseNobodyToRope: Nobody aboard the {VEHICLE} can go down the ropes: only people in a passenger's or crew chief's seat, awake, go.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseNoGroundBelow: There is no open ground behind the {VEHICLE}'s ramp to set anyone down on: it is roofed, built on, hidden or impassable. Move it over open ground.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseHoistNobodyWorks: Nobody else aboard the {VEHICLE} can work the hoist: it needs someone awake in a passenger's or crew chief's seat.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseHoistTooHeavy: {PERSON} and their gear weigh {KILOGRAMS} kg, more than the hoist's {RATED} kg.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseHoistNoHover: The {VEHICLE} could not hold its hover with {PERSON} aboard as well: lighten it, or wait for cooler air.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseHoistNoRoom: There is no free seat aboard the {VEHICLE}.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseCirclingNoHover: The {VEHICLE}'s engines cannot hold it in a hover now, so it keeps circling. Send it somewhere, or land it on a clear strip.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseLandWithLoad: The {VEHICLE} has {LOAD} hanging below: set it down first, or it would be landed on.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseCannotHoverNoStrip: The {VEHICLE}'s engines cannot hold it in a hover now, and it cannot land rolling: it has to keep flying, or circle, until it is lighter or the air cooler.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseStepOut: Nobody can step out of the {VEHICLE} while it is in the air: land it first.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_SpotEdge: part of it would be off the edge of the map
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_SpotUnseen: part of the spot has not been seen
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_SpotRoof: part of the spot is under a roof
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_SpotBuilding: something is built on part of the spot
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_SpotVehicle: another vehicle stands on part of the spot
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_SpotObstructed: trees, bushes or rubble stand on part of the spot
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_SpotGround: part of the ground there cannot take its weight
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_SpotNoFloor: part of it is not a built floor
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_WhyEngines: its engines cannot keep it in the air
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_WhyCannotHover: its engines cannot hold it in a hover
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgLandingToShutDown: The {VEHICLE}'s engines were switched off: it is landing on the nearest clear spot and will shut down there.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgRotorsSpinningUp: The {VEHICLE} is spinning its rotors up: it lifts off once they are up to speed.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_RefuseSpace: The {VEHICLE} cannot fly here: there is no air to hold it up in space.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgEnginesKept: The {VEHICLE}'s engines cannot be stopped in the air, and there is nowhere clear to land nearby: they are kept running. Land it first.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgSpotBlocked: The {VEHICLE} could not set down: {WHY}. It has climbed back up and is holding in a hover; pick another spot.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgHardLanding: The {VEHICLE} came down hard. Its undercarriage and airframe are damaged, and everyone aboard was shaken about.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgWrecked: The {VEHICLE} came down where it could not land ({WHY}) and was wrecked.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgDeparting: The {VEHICLE} is setting off: it flies to the edge of the map on the side of its journey, and leaves from there.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgDepartureCancelled: The {VEHICLE} is no longer leaving: it takes the new order instead.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgCannotLandCircling: The {VEHICLE} cannot hover now, and the ground ahead of its landing spot is not clear for it to land rolling. It is circling over the spot: clear the ground ahead of it, or pick another place to land.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgCirclingInstead: The {VEHICLE}'s engines cannot hold it in a hover, so it circles here instead.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgRoping: The {VEHICLE} is coming down to put {COUNT} people down the ropes.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgRopingDone: Everyone is down the {VEHICLE}'s ropes. It is climbing back up.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgHoistingUp: The {VEHICLE} is coming down to lift {PERSON} aboard on the hoist.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgHoistingDown: The {VEHICLE} is coming down to lower {PERSON} on the hoist.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgHookMissed: {PERSON} was not at the {VEHICLE}'s hook, or could not be taken, so it came back up empty.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgHoistByHand: {WHY} The crew of the {VEHICLE} are winding the hoist by hand, slowly.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgLinesStopping: The {VEHICLE} will send nobody more down its lines, and climbs back once the last one is off.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgLineFall: {PERSON} fell about {METRES} m from the {VEHICLE}'s line as it came down.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgRaiderDown: The {VEHICLE} of {FACTION} came down and was wrecked.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgAllyAircraftWrecked: With nobody left to fly it, the {VEHICLE} of {FACTION} has been wrecked.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgRaiderScuttled: With nobody left to fly it, {FACTION}'s people wrecked their {VEHICLE} rather than let it be taken.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgRollAborted: The {VEHICLE} stopped its take-off roll: {WHY}. It has braked to a stop and is no longer leaving.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgRolledIn: The {VEHICLE} has landed rolling and stopped at the end of its strip.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgRolledShort: The {VEHICLE} had to stop short on its landing roll ({WHY}) and braked hard. Its undercarriage is damaged.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_MsgArrivedSpotRefused: {WHY} The {VEHICLE} has come in over the edge and is holding there; pick another spot.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_InspectFigures: Flight: {DOING}, {METRES} m up, {SPEED} cells a second.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_InspectMargin: Power to hover: {MARGIN} of what it needs.
